title: Original-circle equivariance forces half-period blindness for arbitrary observation maps

theorem.target: H_ps=L2(K/M) with the K1356 original-circle action
theorem.kernel_element: z=C(pi)=[-1,1] acts identically on H_ps by K1711
theorem.hypothesis: F:X->H_ps is C-equivariant as a set map
theorem.identity: F(z.x)=z.F(x)=F(x) for every x in X
theorem.regularity: No linearity, continuity, measurability, differentiability, locality or polynomial hypothesis is used.
theorem.formal_reuse: Restrict the C-action to H=<z> and apply equivariantMapEquivOrbitValuation_of_trivial; this is a composition of a held theorem with K1711, not a new general group-action theorem.

finite_control.target: C2 with C4 action by reduction modulo 2

claim_ceiling: Every original-circle-equivariant observation into the selected complete spherical carrier is blind to the source half-period orbit. This is an internal representation/observation constraint; it does not establish that a source-native physical observation has these source and target actions.
